TIT_103(
    PV_High := 200.0,
    PV_Low := 160.0,
    Scaling_Slope := 15.625,
    Scaling_Offset := -62.5,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
LT_105(
    PV_High := 80.0,
    PV_Low := 20.0,
    Scaling_Slope := 6.25,
    Scaling_Offset := -25.0,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
FC_004();
XV_102(
    Timeout := T#5s,
    Inhibit := TIT_103.High_Alarm);
TIC101_Inhibit_OR := TIT_103.High_Alarm OR XV_102.Alarm_Position_Error OR FC_004.PV_Low_Alarm OR TIT_103.General_Fault;
TIC_101(
    PV := TIT_103.PV,
    SP := 180.0,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0,
    KP := 3.0,
    TR := 1.2,
    TD := 0.1,
    Inhibit := TIC101_Inhibit_OR);
LV_104(
    Control_Signal := LIC_106.XOUT,
    Open_Limit := 100.0,
    Close_Limit := 0.0,
    Inhibit := LT_105.High_Alarm);
SteamNotOpen_NOT := NOT XV_102.FB_Opened;
LIC106_Inhibit_OR := SteamNotOpen_NOT OR LV_104.Alarm OR LT_105.General_Fault;
LIC_106(
    PV := LT_105.PV,
    SP := 50.0,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0,
    KP := 2.5,
    TR := 0.9,
    TD := 0.0,
    Inhibit := LIC106_Inhibit_OR);

(* Outputs published to other sections / HMI. *)
TIT_103_Temperature_C := TIT_103.PV;
LT_105_Level_Percent := LT_105.PV;
TIC_101_Output_Percent := TIC_101.XOUT;
LIC_106_Output_Percent := LIC_106.XOUT;

TIT_106(
    PV_High := 260.0,
    Scaling_Slope := 18.75,
    Scaling_Offset := -75.0,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
LT_107(
    PV_High := 80.0,
    PV_Low := 20.0,
    Scaling_Slope := 6.25,
    Scaling_Offset := -25.0,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
TIC_106(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    PV := TIT_106.PV,
    SP := 200.0,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0,
    KP := -3.0,
    TR := 1.2,
    TD := 0.2);
LIC_107(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    PV := LT_107.PV,
    SP := 50.0,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0,
    KP := 2.5,
    TR := 1.0,
    TD := 0.0);
CONDENSATE_RETURN_VALVE_OPEN_LS();
CondensateNotOpen := NOT CONDENSATE_RETURN_VALVE_OPEN_LS.DI_Out;
SteamValveInhibitLogic := CondensateNotOpen OR TIC_106.PV_High_Alarm;
FV_105(
    Control_Signal := TIC_106.XOUT,
    Open_Limit := 100.0,
    Close_Limit := 0.0,
    Inhibit := SteamValveInhibitLogic);
LV_102(
    Control_Signal := LIC_107.XOUT,
    Open_Limit := 100.0,
    Close_Limit := 0.0,
    Inhibit := LIC_107.PV_Low_Alarm);

(* Outputs published to other sections / HMI. *)
TIT106_ReboilerTemp_PV := TIT_106.PV;
LT107_Column2Level_PV := LT_107.PV;
TIC106_FV105_SteamFlow_MV := TIC_106.XOUT;
LIC107_LV102_Outflow_MV := LIC_107.XOUT;

(* Entry point required by OpenPLC Editor v4. The process sections run as parallel program instances under task0; main only provides a scan heartbeat. *)
Heartbeat := NOT Heartbeat;
